about: Secret Power shows the seventh generation's animation for the ground and the terrain (Pokemon Central, Forzasegreta): Spit Up's on Route 29's plain ground, Confusion's in Psychic Terrain. A level-5 Slowpoke, slower than the forced wild Snorlax that knows only Splash, is given Secret Power and Psychic Terrain (teach:), so its move's animation is the turn's last; gDiagMoveAnimation is the move whose animation was sent last. Before, Secret Power showed its own, retail's, the fourth generation's (Mud-Slap's on plain ground, no terrain). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
